reset_monitor._comment: DUY NHAT chuc nang con lai cua he thong: canh bao phien ket noi SHB <-> NAPAS bi RESET (server-rst/client-rst), doc tu FAZ LOG TRAFFIC. Chay bang script reset_monitor.py. CA server-rst (NAPAS) VA client-rst (SHB) deu dung mo hinh: phien DAU TIEN cua 1 dot -> alert TUC THOI (CRITICAL) + mo cua so server_reset_window_minutes phut; cac phien tiep theo CUNG HUONG -> chi ghi nhan; het 1 chu ky CON reset -> gui SUMMARY roi RENEW (lap lai, khong dong); het 1 chu ky KHONG con reset -> gui RESOLVED roi DONG han cua so. 2 huong (SERVER/CLIENT) co cua so DOC LAP nhau. interval_minutes=1 khop lich AWX quet moi 1 phut - query_lookback_minutes=2 de co dem an toan tranh bo sot khi job chay tre.
